description: Average the points won per death country, with a blank death country kept as its own group. Compare each group's average with the plain average of all group averages, the blank group included.

b.request: Group `player_award_vote` records by the matched player’s `death_country`, keeping blank death countries as their own group; ignore missing `points_won`, and show each country’s unrounded average and its difference from the unrounded simple average of all group averages, including the blank group
b.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM country_averages) AS difference_from_group_average FROM country_averages

c.request: For players who received award votes (matched to `player` by `player_id`), what is the average `points_won` for each death country (ignoring missing points)? Show each death country, its average, and how far it is from the simple average of those per-country averages, without rounding. Average the points won per death country, with a blank death country kept as its own group. Compare each group's average with the plain average of all group averages, the blank group included.
c.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) AS avg_of_country_averages FROM country_averages) SELECT c.death_country, c.avg_points_won, ABS(c.avg_points_won - o.avg_of_country_averages) AS distance_from_average FROM country_averages AS c CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o

a.request: For award vote records matched to their players by `player_id` (dropping votes with no matching player), group by the player's death country (`death_country`), keeping players with a blank death country as their own group. For each group, show the death country, the average `points_won` (ignoring missing values), and how far that average is from the simple average of the group averages across all groups, the blank group included. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, ABS(avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM country_averages)) AS distance_from_group_average FROM country_averages

d.request: For players who received award votes (matched to `player` by `player_id`), what is the average `points_won` for each death country, ignoring missing points and treating a blank death country as its own group? Show each group’s average and its difference from the simple average of all group averages, including the blank group, without rounding.
d.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS difference_from_group_average FROM country_averages
